message:
The fuzzer targets require `-fsanitize=fuzzer` which needs clang. But clang's ASan runtime is missing. Let me check if I can install it or use a different approach. Let me check what's available.

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'ls /usr/lib/llvm-18/lib/clang/18/lib/linux/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -i "clang\|asan" | head -10; echo "---"; find / -name "libclang_rt.asan*" 2>/dev/null | head -5'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
